patch.value: Replace pm spawnSync with in-process PmClient and cursor pagination

Replace per-request pm binary spawns in pm-runner with in-process PmClient/SDK action dispatch; adopt sdk/query cursor pagination and search tuning for list/search; preserve HTTP response shapes; keep realtime convergence.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: FINDING: pm-runner uses async spawn (not spawnSync) for runPm; spawnSync only in src/index.ts (npm install + pm --version probe, not data path). Real defect is per-request spawn via runProcess.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: FINDING: SDK PmClient.run(action,{options}) returns agent-compact shape, not CLI --json verbose envelope. list: SDK has query_summary vs CLI projection/sorting/now; items are superset (priority,parent,updated_at added). search/get/contracts/create/update/close shapes match CLI (additive only). Frontend only reads items/count/total/results -> compatible. Will pass SDK result through; differences are additive or in ignored envelope metadata.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: FINDING: run() accepts single-word kebab flags (status,limit,type) but SILENTLY IGNORES multi-word kebab flags (dry-run, include-body, filter-status). Must convert kebab->camel (includeBody, dryRun, filterStatus) or options are silently dropped (dry-run ignored => mutates!). Verified camel keys work.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: FINDING: Unsupported via PmClient.run (keep spawn fallback): guide, reindex, normalize, dedupe-audit, comments-audit, calendar, test-runs, templates. test action throws TypeError 'r.map is not a function' via run (SDK bug) -> keep spawn. plan: run('plan',{options:{subcommand,id}) does not accept plan id as option key (only typed planShow(id) etc.) -> keep spawn for plan routes (not hot path). pm-graph export/neighbors/query: routes JSON.parse raw extension stdout -> keep spawn.

value.author: codex
value.text: Continuation verification 2026-07-26: the earlier claim that PmClient.run('test') throws r.map is not reproducible when the item id is mapped correctly; both test listing and positional add work in-process, so test was removed from the spawn fallback and covered by a real temporary-workspace test. Found and fixed adapter regressions before merge: init prefix, close/close-task reasons, and comment/note/learning/test text positionals were dropped; --no-* flags were mis-mapped; PmClient cwd differed from the CLI workspace; cached clients were not evicted on project deletion. Added cursor validation that returns HTTP 400 instead of falling through Express as 500. Upstream scalability issue filed: unbraind/pm-cli#742 (process-wide PmClient activation queue head-of-line blocks unrelated workspaces).

patch.value: Supported native pm routes execute through the typed PmClient with CLI-compatible positional and flag semantics; Unsupported maintenance and extension-output commands retain bounded non-blocking fallback execution; List and search endpoints accept bounded opaque cursors and workspace-derived search tuning; Real temporary-workspace tests prove init create comments tests pagination close and expected-error mapping; npm run release:check passes with zero production vulnerabilities

value.author: codex
value.text: SCALABILITY DECISION 2026-07-26: search, update-many, and upgrade remain on the bounded asynchronous process fallback because they can be long-running and the current SDK process-wide activation queue would otherwise head-of-line block unrelated workspaces. Typed SDK cursor contracts/search-tuning helpers still govern the HTTP query surface. This temporary boundary is tracked upstream in unbraind/pm-cli#742.

value.text: PR #65 CodeRabbit follow-up 2026-07-26: corrected inaccurate spawnSync terminology; derived boolean option arity from PM_TOOL_PARAMETERS_SCHEMA; preserved values beginning with -- and explicit --no-* semantics; added verified unsupported-action-only spawn fallback without retrying mutation errors; bounded the PmClient LRU cache; routed stdin/explicit-timeout calls to the cancellable process path; propagated CLI exit codes to consistent HTTP status mapping; validated base64url cursors and bounded search numbers; protected dash-prefixed search terms with the option terminator.
